313.name: Overclocked Spell
313.skilldes:
Channeled spell unleashes an over-limit attack, dealing <color=#ed9053>14000%</color>+<color=#ed9053>7000</color>Adaptive Dmg per second to up to 10 enemies within 15m around you and reducing their max HP by <color=#ed9053>10%</color>(ineffective against Boss, MVP, and Mini), lasting <color=#ed9053>5</color>seconds. This skill cannot be reflected, and PvP skill multiplier is reduced by 50%.
Adaptive Dmg is determined by your highest damage type attribute (Pdmg Bonus%, Mdmg Bonus%), damage range attribute (Melee Pdmg%, Ranged Pdmg%, Ranged Mdmg%), and element attribute (Neutral Dmg%, Water Dmg%, Earth Dmg%, Fire Dmg%, Wind Dmg%, Poison Dmg%, Holy Dmg%, Shadow Dmg%, Ghost Dmg%, Undead Dmg%), which decides damage type and bonus calculation method.
